subtitle: Manage installed Node.js / Python / Java / Maven and switch user/machine environment variables (new terminals pick them up)
emptyHint: Click “Add path” to register an install directory manually
elevateConfirmMessage:
{{reason}}

One UAC prompt will move Node/Python/JDK/Maven from the machine PATH to your user PATH (machine-level JAVA_HOME / MAVEN_HOME are removed too). Later switches won't need approval. Continue?
elevateConfirmWarning: After this, other Windows accounts and programs running as system services will no longer find these runtimes on the machine PATH.
removeConfirmMessage: Remove this path from the list? Files on disk will not be deleted.
uninstallExternalWarning: This version was not installed by this app (source: {{source}}). Its whole directory will be deleted permanently. Tools that manage it (jvman, an IDE, an installer) may stop working with it; for system installs prefer Control Panel > Programs. Directories under Program Files ask for administrator approval once.
uninstallActiveHint: In use — switch to another version before uninstalling
hintRestart: Tip: reopen terminals / IDEs to pick up the new version.
dshStaleHint: {{count}} DSH instance(s) still run the previous runtime
dshRestartMessage: Stops and restarts {{count}} DSH instance(s) so they pick up the runtime just switched to. Running sessions are interrupted.
